info.title: klocgit native API
info.description: Native v0 coordination API for isolated Git Futures, pinned context, composed candidate states, finite evaluation evidence and guarded canonical promotion. The transport authenticates actors and serializes mutations. Reviews and evidence bind exact immutable inputs. Multi-repository promotion is non-atomic and exposes partial recovery. Unlisted top-level mutation fields are discarded; evaluator callbacks preserve their complete signed body.

OwnerBearer.description: Configured single-owner credential. Actor identity comes from server configuration, never request-body input. Local loopback development may explicitly omit token enforcement.

Id.name: id
Id.description: Existing native object or journal identity. URI-encode path values.

400.description: Invalid JSON input, field type or bound; INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_NATIVE_INPUT, INVALID_REPO, INVALID_REF, INVALID_DESCRIPTION or INVALID_IMPORT_SOURCE.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED. Actor or required owner Bearer credential is missing or invalid.

403.description: FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN. Mutating request origin differs from the Worker origin.

404.description: REPO_NOT_FOUND, SYSTEM_NOT_FOUND, OBJECTIVE_NOT_FOUND, FUTURE_NOT_FOUND or REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.

409.description: State or idempotency conflict. IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, REPO_EXISTS, REPOSITORY_NOT_READY, OBJECTIVE_CLOSED, OBJECTIVE_SYSTEM_MISMATCH, CANONICAL_CHANGED, FUTURE_STALE, FUTURE_CHANGED, FUTURE_ABANDONED, FUTURE_NOT_READY, FORK_NAME_COLLISION, FORK_BASELINE_MISMATCH, RECOVERY_REQUIRED or RECOVERY_NOT_REQUIRED. Re-read current state; reconcile uncertain effects instead of blindly replaying mutations.

413.description: PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE. Worker requests are bounded to 1,000,000 bytes.

503.description: AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED, NATIVE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE, REPOSITORY_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, INVALID_PROVIDER_RESULT, INVALID_GIT_FACTS or RECOVERY_REQUIRED. Uncertain provider effects remain journaled.

GitObjectId.description: Immutable commit or tree object ID. Current lifecycle providers use SHA-1 Git repositories.

BranchRef.description: Git branch ref; no '..', '//', trailing slash or segments starting/ending with '.' or ending with '.lock'.

kind.description: Producer declaration, including 'unknown'. This does not authenticate an actor.

url.description: Canonical public HTTPS GitHub or GitLab Git URL. No credentials, query, fragment, port or trailing slash. Private imports and arbitrary hosts are unsupported.

branch.description: Source branch name, validated as a branch ref.
